subLocations.name: The Leaning Man
subLocations.lore: A safe and quiet inn outside the city walls.

subLocations.name: Lilda's
subLocations.lore: A cheap and rowdy [[festhall]].

subLocations.name: Jolly Warrior Inn
subLocations.lore: A posh inn located on the western Mulsantir’s Gate and Westgate Market Street.

subLocations.name: The Spitting Cockatrice
subLocations.lore: Inn favored by merchants, known for average food and extravagant decor.

subLocations.name: The Empty Fish
subLocations.lore: Exuberantly-priced tavern favored as an anonymous meetup space.

subLocations.name: The Westward Eye
subLocations.lore: A large well-guarded inn for merchants and traders.

subLocations.name: The Gatereach Inn
subLocations.lore: A luxurious inn for wealthy merchants along the [[Trader's Road]].

subLocations.name: The Neck
subLocations.lore: The strait that connected the [[Dragonmere]] with the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]].

subLocations.name: Sea of Fallen Stars
subLocations.lore: Or the '''Inner Sea''', the largest inland body of water in [[Faerûn]].

subLocations.name: Purple Lady
subLocations.lore: [[Festhall]] and a tavern renowned for its staff's see-through purple [[robe]]s.

subLocations.name: The Lord's Water
subLocations.lore: A pool.

subLocations.name: Blue Banner
subLocations.lore: A tavern and inn located in [[Westgate]]'s [[Shou Quarter]].

subLocations.name: The Black Boot
subLocations.lore: A dangerous inn near the [[River Bridge]], known for its cheap prices, brawls, and shady characters.

subLocations.name: Rising Raven Inn
subLocations.lore: An inn packed with traders and adventurers, that offered small private apartments.

subLocations.name: The Old Beard
subLocations.lore: A tavern that catered mostly to retired sailors.

subLocations.name: Black Eye
subLocations.lore: A rowdy tavern and a [[festhall]] frequented by dockhands and prostitutes.

subLocations.name: Rotten Root Tavern
subLocations.lore: The establishment best known for its bad food and drink and its sign depicting an evil-looking treant.

subLocations.name: Big Edna's
subLocations.lore: A tiny ramshackle bar that served fishermen and dock worker.

subLocations.name: The Track
subLocations.lore: A heavily-guarded underground racing track and a tavern.

subLocations.name: Blais House
subLocations.lore: [[Mintassan]]'s inn that catered to planar guests, sealed off between the [[Spellplague]] and the [[Second Sundering]].

subLocations.name: The Rosebud
subLocations.lore: An outdoor [[ale]] garden favored by merchants and young nobles.

subLocations.name: Bent Mermaid Inn
subLocations.lore: A shady tavern known for a figurehead of a bent-over [[mermaid]] out the front of the bar.

subLocations.name: Rising Raven Annex
subLocations.lore: An extension of the [[Rising Raven inn]].

subLocations.name: Rising Raven Warehouse
subLocations.lore: An extension of the [[Rising Raven]] inn. Also offered rooms.

subLocations.name: River Thunn
subLocations.lore: The river that ran from the high lands of the [[Dragon Coast]] down into the harbor of [[Westgate]].
